name: Taakid: COD Confirmation
subtitle: Confirm COD orders on WhatsApp and stop shipping to refusers
introduction: Confirm cash-on-delivery orders on WhatsApp in one tap and stop shipping parcels that get refused.
details: Taakid puts every new cash-on-delivery order on a confirmation board, on hold until the buyer says yes. Tap WhatsApp and a ready message opens in your own WhatsApp, in Darija, Gulf Arabic, Arabic, French or English, written in the buyer's language and currency. One click records the answer: confirmed orders are released to ship, refused ones never leave. When a parcel is refused at the door, Taakid remembers that buyer and can hide cash on delivery from them at checkout.
features: WhatsApp confirmation in one tap, from your own WhatsApp, with no API or fees
Messages in Darija, Gulf Arabic, Arabic, French and English, per country
Holds every COD order until it is confirmed, so only confirmed orders ship
Remembers buyers who refused a delivery and flags their next order
Hides cash on delivery at checkout for refusers, big carts or regions

instruction_notes:
WHAT THE APP DOES
Taakid helps cash-on-delivery merchants confirm orders with the buyer before shipping. New COD orders appear on the app's board (Confirm orders) and are put on a Shopify fulfillment hold. The merchant taps WhatsApp, which opens wa.me in a new tab with a ready message, then records the answer. Confirmed releases the hold. The app never sends messages itself and needs no WhatsApp API.

HOW TO TEST
1. Install the app. The board opens with a Getting started card.
2. In your store, make sure a manual payment method named Cash on Delivery (COD) is active (Settings > Payments > Manual payment methods), and set Settings > Checkout > Shipping address phone number to Required.
3. Place an order on the storefront and choose Cash on Delivery at checkout, with a phone number such as +212 612 345 678. If your store cannot complete a manual payment, create the order in admin instead: Orders > Create order > add a product and a customer with that phone > Payment due later > Create order. Taakid treats unpaid hand-made orders as COD.
4. Open Taakid. The order is on the board, marked On hold. In Shopify the order shows a hold named Taakid.
5. Tap WhatsApp: wa.me opens with the message in the buyer's language (Darija for Morocco, Gulf Arabic for the UAE and Saudi Arabia). Tap Confirmed: the hold is released and the order is tagged taakid-confirmed.
6. Refuser memory: on the Confirmed tab, click Refused at delivery. Place a second COD order with the same phone number. It arrives flagged Refused 1x before, tagged taakid-refused-before, and held.
7. Checkout rule: in Settings, turn on the checkout rule and save. Start a new checkout with that same phone number: Cash on Delivery is not offered. A different phone number still sees it.
8. Plans: open Plans and choose a paid plan; on a development store the charge is a test charge. The current plan shows on the Plans page and on Shopify's app billing page.

DEMO STORE
https://offeros-dev.myshopify.com (password: ana). Products are in dirhams for Morocco.

DATA
The app reads buyer name, phone and city from the order to show them on the board and build the message. None of them is stored; phone numbers are kept only as a keyed one-way hash to recognise returning buyers. Requested scopes: orders (read, tags, cancel on request), merchant-managed fulfillment orders (holds), payment customizations (checkout rule).
